# `/access-request-identity-metrics` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /access-request-identity-metrics/v1/{identityId}/requested-objects/{requestedObjectId}/type/{type}

`getAccessRequestIdentityMetricsV1` — Return access request identity metrics

Use this API to return information access metrics.

- Scopes: idn:access-request-approvals:manage, idn:access-request-approvals:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — Manager's identity ID.
  - `requestedObjectId` (path, required) — Requested access item's ID.
  - `type` (path, required) — one of ENTITLEMENT, ROLE, ACCESS_PROFILE — Requested access item's type.
- Returns 200: object
